text: RESOLVED: Recording stays monocular (one Gaze per Sample); add a separate BinocularRecording[U] holding paired samples with left/right/cyclopean(Fusion) projections and a vergence signal. Detectors run on Recording, so the 95% monocular path stays simple; vergence, disparity and binocular-coordination analyses demand the paired type explicitly. Rationale: two independently-filtered and resampled recordings no longer share a sample index, so disparity becomes unrecoverable rather than merely absent. Forcing deadline the PRD missed: ASC ingest lands at v0.6, and with no binocular type a binocular file silently loses an eye -- the eyesim failure mode. Type lands v0.3; binocular ANALYSES deferred past v1.0. New bead: c-binocular.
